kyara.intro: A player requests the import, then adds the Kiraku account as a friend on Kyara. A team member (admin or dev) opens that friend's profile on Kyara and clicks their bookmarklet: Kiraku finds the request through the avatar's Discord and grants it right away. Only doubtful reads wait, in “To check”. Our server never calls Kyara.
